articles.title: EA FC 27 Shooting Ratings List: Kylian Mbappe misses top spot, Cristiano Ronaldo edges out Lionel Messi
articles.standfirst: The upcoming soccer video game from EA Sports has revealed rankings for the top shooters in the sport.
articles.summary: The upcoming soccer video game from EA Sports has revealed rankings for the top shooters in the sport.
articles.body:
Soccer fans will soon get their annual video game fix, with EA Sports FC 27 set to launch worldwide on September 25 . Many details have already been revealed, including Kylian Mbappe gracing the coveted cover of the game.

This week, fans got exactly what they've been waiting for: ratings for the top players in the game. EA Sports launched a database for their player ratings reveal , and fans were particularly interested in the top shooters the game has to offer. Shooting takes into account a player's finishing ability and other factors, so there might not be too many surprises at the top.

Harry Kane has the best shooting rating in EA Sports FC 27

Despite gracing the cover, Mbappe wasn't able to secure the top spot. Not much further down, Cristiano Ronaldo and Lionel Messi appeared like they always do, but it's the former who slightly edged out the Argentinian.

Harry Kane : 90 overall, 94 shooting

Erling Haaland : 91 overall, 92 shooting

Kylian Mbappe : 91 overall, 91 shooting

Ousmane Dembele : 90 overall, 89 shooting

Lautaro Martinez : 87 overall, 88 shooting

Cristiano Ronaldo : 84 overall, 88 shooting

Lionel Messi : 89 overall, 87 shooting

Alexander Isak : 86 overall, 87 shooting

Viktor Gyokeres : 86 overall, 87 shooting

Jude Bellingham : 90 overall, 86 shooting

It's incredible that Ronaldo and Messi are still showing up on such lists. Messi, in particular, has a Top 20 overall rating . Putting together a fantastic 2026 FIFA World Cup likely played a role in his high rating for the new game.

Meanwhile, Mbappe and Erling Haaland can say they stand alone at the top. They are the only two players who are above 90 overall .

articles.title: NBA 2K27 Release Date: When does the new NBA game come out and how to get early access?
articles.standfirst: The new game launches worldwide in September, but premium editions unlock it well before then
articles.summary: The new game launches worldwide in September, but premium editions unlock it well before then
articles.body:
NBA 2K27 officially arrives worldwide on September 4, but the real launch begins much sooner for players willing to buy one of the game’s premium editions.

2K has confirmed that early access opens on August 26 at 9:00 a.m. PT for anyone who purchases the Deluxe Edition or Ultra Edition. That creates a window of up to nine days before the Standard Edition becomes playable.

The August 26 date also marks the start of Season 1, meaning early-access players will immediately begin earning XP and progressing through the new rewards system rather than simply getting a head start on exhibition games.

Victor Wembanyama , the Standard Edition cover athlete, headlines the opening season.

How to play NBA 2K27 before September 4

The key requirement is the edition. Players who buy the Standard Edition will have to wait until the worldwide launch on September 4.

Those who purchase the Deluxe Edition or Ultra Edition can begin on August 26, although the exact local unlock time may vary by region.

NBA 2K27 will be available on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2 and PC through Steam . There won't be a version for older-generation consoles.

The Ultra Edition is digital-only on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and PC, while NBA 2K26 players on PlayStation, Xbox and Steam can receive a 10 percent loyalty discount when pre-ordering the Ultra Edition on the same platform through September 3.

The Deluxe and Ultra editions are not available in Belgium, Brazil or South Korea.

Season 1 gives early-access players plenty to chase

Players entering on August 26 will have immediate access to NBA 2K27 Season 1, which features a 40-level rewards ladder across The City and MyTEAM.

The City rewards include Skill Boosts, MyPLAYER cosmetics, Cap Breakers and new Badge Tokens.

MyTEAM progression includes cards ranging from Amethyst to Dark Matter, with Derrick Rose available as the Level 40 reward.

Season 1 also brings back 2XREP Weekends and limited-time events such as Midway and Blackout, while the soundtrack leans heavily into New York basketball culture with artists including Busta Rhymes and Mobb Deep .

Players who want even more rewards can purchase the Pro Pass or Hall of Fame Pass, each of which adds another 40 levels of premium content.

Those passes are separate purchases and require the base game, an internet connection and an NBA 2K account.

The simplest way to look at the launch is that September 4 is the official worldwide release, but August 26 is the date for anyone who wants to be there from the first tip.

articles.title: NBA 2K27 Builder: What are the new features for building characters that you must know?
articles.standfirst: Female MyPLAYERs, Signature Blueprints and a deeper Badge system lead the changes.
articles.summary: Female MyPLAYERs, Signature Blueprints and a deeper Badge system lead the changes.
articles.body:
NBA 2K27 is making major changes to the MyPLAYER Builder , giving players more control over how they create and develop characters before taking them into MyCareer, Park, Rec and ProAm.

One of the biggest additions is the introduction of female MyPLAYERs , created with the same skill-based attribute system used for male characters.

2K says NBA 2K27 features the "First-Ever Female MyPLAYERs," while also overhauling Badges, Takeovers, Cap Breakers and build progression.

What has changed in the NBA 2K27 Builder?

Players can still create a completely custom character, choosing position, height, weight and wingspan before allocating attributes.

NBA2KLab notes that those measurements determine the maximum ratings a build can reach across 21 attributes, including shooting, finishing, defense, physicals and playmaking.

A major new option is Signature Blueprints.

These replace the old Pro Tuned and NBA templates and provide 40 athlete-inspired builds at launch, each combining elements from three NBA or WNBA players. More Blueprints are expected to be added during future Seasons.

Badge Loadouts are also new. Every MyPLAYER starts with one, while up to three more can be earned through REP, Challenges and Crews. Players can switch between different Badge setups before games depending on their matchup.

Build Specialization gets another major upgrade

Build Specialization now has six disciplines: Shooting, Finishing, Playmaking, Defense, Rebounding and the newly added Physicals category.

Each specialization contains 10 objective-based quests, with rewards including cosmetics, Badge Tokens, Cap Breakers and a permanent Synergy upgrade for completing the track.

Cap Breakers are also easier to plan.

Players can preview how they affect a build before committing, rather than fully creating a MyPLAYER and entering The City first. That should reduce the risk of wasting valuable upgrades on a poorly optimized build.

The result is a Builder that puts more emphasis on planning before spending VC.

With Signature Blueprints for players who want a faster starting point and deeper customization for those who prefer building from scratch, NBA 2K27 gives users considerably more flexibility over how their MyPLAYER develops.
